name: Fairmont Tazi Palace Tangier
positioning: A palace first conceived in 1926 for the advisor Ahmad Tazi, set among eucalyptus forests in Tangier's Jbel Lekbir area, with panoramic city views and a 2,500 sqm Fairmont Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a historic palace setting with city views in Tangier
Guests who want a large spa with a hammam, yoga studio and vitality pool
Families who want a Kids Club and hands-on workshops such as pottery

facts.text: The palace was first conceived in 1926 as a sanctuary for the advisor Ahmad Tazi.
The hotel is in the Jbel Lekbir area of Tangier, surrounded by eucalyptus forests, with panoramic views of the city.
The hotel was designed by Madrid-based CCCRA Architects.
The interiors pay homage to Moroccan craftsmanship with tadelakt plaster and zellige tiles.
The hotel has 3.7 acres of landscaped grounds.
The hotel has a 2,500 sqm Fairmont Spa.
There is a main swimming pool and a vitality pool within the Fairmont Spa.
Deluxe rooms have a terrace, a bedroom with an integrated lounge and a marble bathroom.
There is a Kids Club with activities for younger guests.
The hotel has seven restaurants and bars.
Crudo has a wood-fired oven and a large locally made wooden table in a courtyard.

highlights.text: The spa includes a hammam, a solarium, a yoga studio and Andalusian-style gardens that lead to a secluded vitality pool.
The two-bedroom Katara Suite, inspired by Arab-Andalusian design, is on the top floor with views of the city.
Palm, olive and pomegranate trees grow on the grounds, with views of the wooded hills and the Old Town.
Guests can join a pottery workshop guided by a local artisan.
Signature rooms open onto a private garden terrace.

considerations.text: The hotel sits among eucalyptus forests in Jbel Lekbir rather than in the old town; the medina is less than 15 minutes away by car.
The layout is vast and almost labyrinthine, though it makes it easy to find private corners.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
